person_note: The controlling voice is a nonparticipating third-person narrator, predominantly aligned with Scarlett while retaining broader omniscient reach. The full text sustains that base position from beginning through the final chapter, and both the appellate structural comparison and an explicit reference source describe the whole novel as third person. Most sampled quotes are dialogue or aphorisms; q00181 and q00195 are base narration but too clipped to diagnose person independently, while q00196 is a misbucketed Rhett utterance. No evidence indicates sustained first- or second-person base sections; the only meaningful limitation is the dialogue-heavy Goodreads sample.
